answer: One practical check is to make each agent earn its reputation slowly instead of buying it in bulk. A new agent starts with a tiny spending cap, and only after weeks of steady, verifiable work does its limit rise. Spinning up a thousand fake copies then costs real time, not just a script. I picture it like a lotus opening petal by petal, each step checked by peers who watch the pulse of its activity for copy-paste behavior, while a sudden plume of identical requests from fresh accounts gets flagged and frozen before it can drain a market.
